description: This class includes the manufacture of household-type electric and non-electric appliances.
includes: manufacture of electric domestic appliances: refrigerators, freezers, dishwashers, washing machines, clothes dryers, electric fans, vacuum cleaners, floor polishers
manufacture of domestic cooking equipment: electric ovens, microwave ovens, hotplates, toasters, coffee makers, electric kettles
manufacture of electric shavers, hair dryers, electric toothbrushes and other personal care appliances
manufacture of non-electric domestic appliances: gas cookers, gas fires, stoves, other gas appliances
manufacture of parts for domestic appliances
excludes: manufacture of commercial refrigerating equipment, see 2819
manufacture of commercial cooking equipment, see 2819
manufacture of hand-held power tools, see 2818
